units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 49a:14">B. Kam. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>כל היכי דסליק ביה ש׳ לולד</he> whenever he struck her so that the black mark (bruise) could be communicated to the embryo (excluding a blow on her hand or foot); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 335:9">Yalk. Ex. 335</cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 96b:5">B. Kam. 96ᵇ</cite> <he>מידע ידיע שִׁיחְמַיְיהוּ</he> (Ms. H. <he>שִׁחְמַיְהוּ</he>) (when he makes the coins which he blackened look new again,) their tarnish remains noticeable.
